context7.description: Real-time, version-pinned documentation for Tree-sitter WASM API, TypeScript Compiler API, fast-check, and Amazon Bedrock SDK. Prevents Kiro agent from hallucinating library method signatures during AST engine development.

aws-knowledge.description: AWS service documentation for Amazon Bedrock SDK integration into the blast-radius and mutator pipelines.

localstack.description: Emulates serverless AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB) locally for chaos fault validation without live AWS credentials.

awsSecurityAnalyzer.description: Validates chaos fault impact against cloud security configurations in App 1 (infrashield-chaos). Feeds real vulnerability data into contracts.ts data shapes.

localstackAWS.description: Emulates Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB for local blast-radius testing without live AWS spend.

sonarQubeSnykAikido.description: Scans for real security vulnerabilities and code smells in the AST output. Results are mapped into the typed risk report structures in contracts.ts.
